release_notes: Cloaking can now act as a gate: tick "Send clean visitors to the next stream" on a cloak stream and bots keep getting the Safe Page while real visitors continue down your stream list. The Device, OS, Browser and Language filters get dropdown pickers with the exact values the tracker recognises (including in-app browsers like TikTok and Facebook). The Language filter now understands regions: "en" matches any English, "en-IN" matches India only. The click id in the full logs opens the click details card. Note: a Language filter saved with a region (e.g. "en-US") is now strictly that region — use the bare "en" for any English.
